nodes.name: Prepare the escalation
nodes.notes: Runs when any LeadPilot workflow fails (their settings point here).

nodes.name: Escalate on the dashboard

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ executionId: String($execution.id), type: 'escalation', message: $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.message, leadId: $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.leadId }) }}

nodes.notes: Shows the escalation on the dashboard. Fails quietly when the backend itself is down (checked at the end).

nodes.name: Record the escalation

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ executionId: $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.executionId, workflow: $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.workflow, leadId: null, status: 'escalated', attempts: 1, maxAttempts: 1, lastError: $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.failedNode + ': ' + $('Prepare the escalation').item.json.error }) }}

nodes.notes: Marks the failed run as escalated on the dashboard.

nodes.name: Did the dashboard get it?
nodes.notes: Makes an escalation that could not reach the dashboard visible here instead.
